extracted.intended_audience: nonprofit organizations and community groups requesting ticket or donation support from Laugh Factory
extracted.subtask_short: ticket donation request to Laugh Factory
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for organizations seeking donated tickets or other donations from the Laugh Factory; explains required documentation, deadlines, mailing instructions, eligible causes, and exclusions. Specific to Laugh Factory club locations (Hollywood, Long Beach, Chicago).

rubrics_metrics.name: Donation Request — email before sending materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Please email us BEFORE sending any printed materials, letters, or envelopes for your organization's event. Unsolicited Donation Requests will NOT be fulfilled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Email first so the request can be processed; do not mail materials unless instructed. Unsolicited mailed requests will not be acted upon.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization Name and Tax ID number
rubrics_metrics.description: We need to know who you are, and that you are a real organization that can be verified. If you do not include the Tax ID number, we will be unable to process the request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide full organization name and Tax ID for verification and Laugh Factory's tax record-keeping; omission prevents processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Event Date and Ticket Expiration
rubrics_metrics.description: All donation requests must include an event date which donated tickets will expire three months from.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Always state the event date. Donated tickets will have an expiration tied to that date (tickets expire three months from the event date).

rubrics_metrics.name: Responsible Party's Contact Information
rubrics_metrics.description: We need to know who to contact if there are questions or concerns, and who will be responsible for handling the donation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include reliable contact details for a person responsible; if Laugh Factory can't reasonably contact someone who knows about the request, the request may be denied.

rubrics_metrics.name: Donation Request Information — be specific and thorough
rubrics_metrics.description: Please be as specific and thorough as possible in this section. It is a lot quicker and easier to process requests if we know what exactly is being requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain exactly what you are requesting and specify how the donation will be used. The more information provided, the better the evaluation. Requests that require guessing or lack purpose detail may be denied.

rubrics_metrics.name: Donation Deadlines / Lead Time
rubrics_metrics.description: Please be considerate when sending a donation request and give us adequate time to process it. Last minute requests are likely to be denied if we don't have adequate time to review them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide at least 1 month lead time, preferably 2 months or more. Short notice is more likely to be denied, especially during busy seasons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promotional Materials and Acknowledgments
rubrics_metrics.description: We always welcome acknowledgments, website links, and being included in your promotional or event materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you will mention Laugh Factory, indicate this on the form so Laugh Factory can provide contact/website information, logos, company images, or 'donated by' signage—if requested ahead of time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cover Letter on Organization Letterhead
rubrics_metrics.description: Please include a cover letter on your organization's letterhead.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a detailed description of your organization and the nature of the request on official letterhead for quick reference and context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include a Letter-Sized Self Addressed Stamped Envelope (SASE)
rubrics_metrics.description: And most importantly: Include a Letter-Sized Self Addressed Stamped Envelope. If we do not receive a stamped envelope, we will not send out a donation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Send a sturdy, secure, letter-sized stamped envelope to ensure the donated tickets can be safely mailed back to you; absence of SASE prevents mailing of donation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mailing Addresses and Club-Specific Contacts
rubrics_metrics.description: Mail your donation request to the appropriate club address and donation coordinator (Hollywood, Long Beach, Chicago) and use the listed contact options for questions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Hollywood: Attn: Elisabeth Aguilar, Donation Coordinator, 8001 Sunset Blvd. Los Angeles, CA 90046 (call (323) 656-1336 ext. 1). Long Beach: Attn: Long Beach Donations Coordinator, 151 S. Pine Ave. Long Beach, CA 90802 (call (562) 495-2844 ext. 1). Chicago: Attn: Curtis Flagg Shaw, Donation Coordinator, 3175 N. Broadway St. Chicago, IL 60657 (call (773) 327-3175). There are also 'Here' email/contact links on the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prioritization — local organizations first
rubrics_metrics.description: We support the community in many ways and receive hundreds of requests each month. In order to fulfill as many as practical and stay within our budgetary restraints, we will give priority to local organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Local organizations are prioritized when allocating limited donation resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supported Cause Types
rubrics_metrics.description: We support charities that benefit children, education, needy families and animal welfare.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requests aligning with these types of causes are more likely to be supported.

rubrics_metrics.name: Excluded Recipient Types
rubrics_metrics.description: We do not provide f unding to individuals, religious organizations, sporting events, and private parties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requests from these categories will be declined; plan accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Processing depends on thoroughness and verifiability
rubrics_metrics.description: The more information we have, the better we are able to determine the merits of your request. If we have to guess as to what you are looking for, or we can't find out what it will be used for, your request may be denied.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete, verifiable submissions (Tax ID, contact person, clear purpose, lead time, SASE, letterhead) speed processing and improve chances of fulfillment.
